Maria: Pushed a short perf dump from last night's Dedicated run. saw weird eviction churn after ~1h of 16k context sequences. https://internal.perf/reports/2034600000 :eyes:
Sam: link works for me. quick summary?
Maria: kv_pool occupancy creeping to 94% then a rapid sweep that freed little, followed by frequent small evicts (~8-12 frames) instead of single large reclamation. latency spike ~120ms p50->p95 during sweeps.
Chen: any config drift vs Hosted? thresholds/lease_time different?
Maria: yeah, Dedicated had kv_pool_threshold=0.9 and lease_time_ms=1500, Hosted is 0.85 + lease_time_ms=800. Private (onprem) is weird: kube node oom_killer pressure earlier in logs.
Alex: I ran a short profiling run on an onprem A100 box — saw a pattern where pagealign mismatches + MTU fragmentation on VPC hosts slowed the page reclaim path and prevented coalescing. small evicts + fragmentation = repeated allocations.
Maria: paste from perf agent:
```
perf-bot summary: kv_reclaim_cycles: 1123
avg_eviction_size_frames: 9.6
page_frag_percent: 22.4
kv_warm_hit_rate: 0.78 -> 0.62 post-sweep
heap_backoff_events: 47
```
Sam: interesting. so Dedicated's higher threshold delays sweeps until fragmentation is worse -> smaller effective free chunks -> thrash. lowering threshold should trigger earlier larger reclaims.
Chen: also batch_window_ms appears different between deployments. Dedicated had batch_window_ms=10 in the scheduler which amplifies hot-path accumulation. Hosted uses 5ms, Private we set to 15ms for throughput. Combined with long contexts this makes more kv churn.
Alex: suggested quick experiment: set kv_pool_threshold=0.82 and batch_window_ms=6 on a canary Dedicated pool, run 2h regen test with long context synthetic load. If p95/loss drops and avg_eviction_size increases -> good sign.
Maria: will run tomorrow AM. also will check kernel selection logs — we saw fallback to fallback-kernel-v2 on some steps which has different page alignment behavior.
perf-bot: Automated note: scheduled profiling job 2034600000-1 started on canary-dedicated-2. ETA 2h.
deploy-bot: Canary config patch queued by Maria: change kv_pool_threshold/batch_window scaling. will notify on rollout. :thumbsup:
Sam: if the onprem nodes are hitting NUMA imbalance, that could explain slower coalesce. maybe try jemalloc tune on Private, and hugepage alignment test.
Chen: adding config matrix to the ticket. also can we add a tiny probe into runtime: report seq_len distrib + eviction size histogram in metrics? that'll make regressions obvious.
Maria: done, added metrics in runtime branch and linked in the ticket. I'll post results once canary finishes. cheers. :coffee:
